description: This file defines configuration options and utility functions for creating Slack WebClient instances with specific retry policies. It manages default, retry, and write-specific configurations, providing functions to instantiate Slack WebClients with these options.

methods.name: export function resolveSlackWebClientOptions(options: WebClientOptions = {}): WebClientOptions { resolveSlackWebClientOptions
methods.description: Merge default options with user-supplied options, ensuring retryConfig defaults to SLACK_DEFAULT_RETRY_OPTIONS.

methods.name: export function resolveSlackWriteClientOptions(options: WebClientOptions = {}): WebClientOptions/ resolveSlackWriteClientOptions
methods.description: Merge default options with user-supplied options, ensuring retryConfig defaults to SLACK_WRITE_RETRY_OPTIONS.

methods.name: export function createSlackWebClient(token: string, options: WebClientOptions = {}) { createSlackWebClient
methods.description: Create a new WebClient instance for Slack using the provided token and options, with retry settings resolved.

methods.name: export function createSlackWriteClient(token: string, options: WebClientOptions = {}) { createSlackWriteClient
methods.description: Create a new WebClient instance tailored for write operations with Slack, using specific retry options.
